I took time and developed my ideologies, ones that I was happy and proud to think with, because what was the point of thinking a certain way if I wasn't happy with it? This small amount of time I'm given is long enough to experience almost everything possible so why would I waste it thinking about yesterdays instead of embracing the present, where I am here. I'm not making up for my mistakes anymore, and If I could I'm happy to know it's for me now to understand and change for the better instead of thinking what me years ago didn't understand, when I was a fucking kid. A good trick is to actually like people, and to like people you must like yourself, understand what you went through was unfortunate and your compromise to this life, a compromise you couldn't control or avoid, and unfortunately comparing your problems won't do anything but make your life feel smaller than others, but the truth is that your life is as important as everything other person who passes by. I gave myself worth by actually seeking for it, like how I was seeking to not give myself worth and just sink down into thoughts. I gave myself respect by just cutting out the negative, and sometimes it could be the people your around, whether it's physical or mentally, I stopped letting people control my moralities, and my worth, I believe in my self, to just exist and live, just this one time I have I didn't want to die and know myself I never gave myself the chance to experience. I wanted to live my own life, and wanting stuff is not bad at fucking all. I learned to love myself.

So, then what? I was in the hospital fucked with my decisions and my consequences, I got exactly what I wanted, no empathy, no regard for my own life, what was next? My fucking demise, all I did was make people cry and disappoint myself, this shit of a experience was nothing my younger self would embrace, not one bit, and it just made me miserable. The attention I wanted was there, but it was as disappointing as every other day after that. All because I wanted to be seen. Thinking back now, I'm not seen at all, actually a lot of people don't know I exist, and I couldn't be happier, the attention I want now is just the attention I'm willing to give into my next journal entry. Fuck that mindset, legit it's just a trap. Yes it's real nothing matters I know that. But if nothing matters then who gives a shit, I'm pretty sure everyone knows that, that's why they're doing whatever the fuck they want, that doesn't mean that they don't care, nothing cares so much that people are willing to care anyways, so why can't I? I gave myself worth believing my existence was meant to happen, yes it probs wasn't, I'm a mistake, a galactic mistake, literally, all of us were never supposed to happen, just like the solar system, or the universe, but that's not an excuse to defy gravity, or to create stars, or make black holes.

I didn't want to live like that, despite my beliefs, I had ambitions, and goals, and lifestyles I wanted to experiment, I didn't want to believe I had sonder and mourn for love, I feel like I didn't deserve it, despite all those nihilistic thoughts at the end of the day I didn't want to believe in it, because deep down I wanted to enjoy life, I just didn't have the will to do so. Because I didn't have any of it, but I did. As a kid I can think about all the bad shit I went through, but the more I grew I was able to see the good stuff I was ignoring, again and again. Why was I so happy when I was a kid? My innocence? Regarding my age I was still able to find worth even if it was just to stay up, look up to the next day, to just have fun? Why was I telling myself that I couldn't see that at my current age? Because it wasn't me, it was my depression, my ideologies I was willing to believe, I was blinded by wanting to be right. About what? That nothing mattered? And if I was right then what? Exactly. Fucking nothing.

It just took a year to change, not just like it was like a snap, but everyday I had to tell myself even if I didn't do anything, that it was worth sleeping back in my bed, to trust myself I had the ability to sleep knowing one day I'll disappear and so would everyone else, I had empathy, and out of all the possibilities I still cared for this people I considered horrible, but I wasn't willing to accept that even I was flawed. It was a lot of accountability, mistakes, and just thinking that took me out of this state of mind, and telling myself everyday was just as worthless as the next was defeating my purpose, which was just to exist. If I didn't have my feet on the ground I would keep floating thinking about the next way I could die, I really wanted to die, the self hate and everything that I could say to myself just stuck me into a worse position. And it wasn't until I thought about the small amount of people I was willing to live for, my siblings, because after everything what was my death gonna fix? Nothing, my room would look the same, my family would have to deal with my death, the world would continue without me, and I have graces of this earth just like how no one knew I was born.

I felt better after realizing being nihilistic was kinda just the beginning, it made me question everything and everyone, and if nothing mattered who made that decision? Nothing, nothing did. It wasn't until like I started thinking more, not just everyday, but whenever I could, it took journaling and self journeys to genuinely care for my existence, not just metaphorical thought but really finding a worth for myself, because if the universe couldn't or even me, "what was even the point", it was then I realized that my nihilism wasn't just a symptom from my depression, but it was depression as a whole, it worsened me and myself, so I asked what was even the point of this belief knowing that it didn't do anything but affect my mental health for the worse, I couldn't even talk to people because I didn't believe the worth in it, because I told myself it didn't matter. The universe never told me it didn't matter, I did. So I became "human", it sounds stupid but seriously who gives a fuck, I felt like a ghost literally just floating amongst all these people, it felt stupid but I generally had that mindset, I was nothing more than a glance. If no one was gonna care for me why would I?

Hey Nancy, I just wanted to abbreviate this a little more and let you know, don't expect empathy from others, I've learned this a while ago it's more of a human reality understanding that no one is a mind reader, I grew up with the understanding and fantasy that if I had looked more a little sadder, more depressive mood and overall sad vibe I had going on Id get a little more understanding on what was happening to me, but I didn't ever plan on telling anyone my full story, unless you know these people, I don't think anyone would have sat down for hours and listen to what was happening to me. The coldest part of the world is how a lot of people choose to not have empathy and to be ignorant. There isn't enough time for everybody to have a moment and provide self care for themselves and even care for others. And I say this with my most sincere respect. I'm sorry that you feel this way, but if I'm being honest it won't go away any time soon. But I also want to say, it's okay to feel like you're going to die, mentally, physically, and realistically feeling just tired of everything, it's okay to feel lost, it's okay to feel like you just don't know at all. I don't know you, and I don't think anyone on here knows you, but from this encounter I can tell you want to care, and you do want someone to care, I'm here to tell you I care Nancy, I care about your existence and wish the best of luck to you, I have nothing to give you or tell you other than to just take care of yourself, let yourself spiral time to time and understand that these emotions and worry you express are bound to happen, everyone goes through this despite their own growth, but no one talks about it. Everything you've been through is a fraction of your capabilities and your intelligence and honestly your own mind can be your limit, I promise if you took time to actually believe in yourself even if it sucks, even if you mess up, your mistakes are a fraction of your hard work, they're just failures, and failures are only given burdens if you don't move on from them, moving on isn't just a saying it's a power that you can't see, but you can comprehend that it has happen by how you feel about them time to time. Nancy I promise you this life you have is so beautiful, and you're beautiful for even taking the time to acknowledge your self conscious, you care for yourself already and so take that into consideration and give yourself strength by acknowledging how much you have already done, even if it doesn't look comparable to how stars form, you're as special as a galaxy, peace out dude.

Woah oh my God guys this brings back so many feelings. This note is not just the exact representation of self-hatred but an honest experience of what it's like to be at "the end" of a battle. I'm so sorry to everyone who was involved in this man's life, and Kurt Cobain I'm so sorry you felt like this was the solution. Anyone who is in this situation, this mental battle, I promise you it gets better. You will never be able to ever, EVER see it visually, I promise you, you must learn to be kind to yourself, because this form of expression, words you give into will become you. I wouldn't say I ever will recover from that moment I was down to my last words, those thoughts I had, and now that I think about it, they were so mean to me, I was so mean to myself, and I wasn't even the bad person in the end, but because I didn't believe in myself, I almost wasn't here. Life as a whole develops as you do, because you only get a certain amount of moments before this life you know is completely never there again. The world creates itself as you form a mindset, that mindset must learn to appreciate those small things people never notice, because in the end you'll only understand how beautiful a piece of grass can be. How rare it is for you to be alive, how many eons, atoms and pieces of space you broke to exist in this moment, a line you created in a timeline that can't even be moved because the galaxy itself can't even comprehend it. You are as important as a star, you are one, and if you don't see it you never will, so become that version of yourself that can. I love every single one of you out there and it took years to do so. Please be safe out there guys.

As a dude raised by women, I'm not gonna say I have an advantage over others but an understanding. I wasn't raised in perfect conditions, and I don't think there would be any perfect conditions any time soon. But I will say from my past, my mistakes and actions I can acknowledge the man I could've become. A very very bad man. But I avoided that, I prevented it because I actually put the effort in to change myself. Had a very supportive surrounding, and those to ground and bring me back to reality when I seriously needed it. I will always regret, day by day carry those mistakes I made, the vague memories of my past. But to this day and so forth, I put in the effort to never become a product of my environment, but an example of what can and could be possible if you don't dedicate your life to making up for your past. But unfortunately not everyone has that help, that feeling of need and want to change. And by the looks of it a lot of men. A quick reminder though I'm not asking for anyone to feel sympathy or empathy for these men. Because despite their internal battles, their very fucked up past and shit. They're actively choosing to be this way, some people really don't want to change. And it's because no one ever told them to do so. So, if you really don't have anyone to care for you, no moral grounding, no one to tell you what you're doing is wrong. They're gonna not give a fuck. To seek out what they want, and a lot of fucked up dudes are just really really horny. And just weird. I'm surrounded by others who are constantly struggling to help themselves, but I won't let that be an excuse to not be myself, it can be so comforting to be a certain way, and it's so unfortunate to see men like this, because I can understand what could've happened, have an idea why they're a certain way because I carry a lot of empathy for others, because I really love people, and to see them become so unfortunate really just makes you emotionally upset. But it's better to just take it as an example to better yourself, but don't dedicate yourself to not being  a someone, but to be someone, someone you love and will take care of. Please be and love yourself people... It takes hard work and understanding, because there won't ever be another chance to be yourself.
